title: Refactor CI: split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism
author: Ethan Li
description: Motivation: Our combined CI workflow has grown slow and brittle as we add more matrix axes and release automation steps. This PR splits the monolith into focused workflows (lint, test, release), introduces reusable workflow templates, and improves caching/parallelism behavior to reduce overall runtime and cache miss rate. Changes include: split lint and test jobs into separate workflows to allow independent run/queueing; extract common job steps into .github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml for easier reuse; tighten cache keys and restore-keys for actions/cache to reduce unnecessary cache churn; pin a subset of GH Actions to stable major versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) and update release action usage; add job-level concurrency and incremental matrix optimizations (reduce node matrix for lint, split integration tests into staged jobs); add a small helper script scripts/ci/cache-key.sh to generate deterministic cache keys based on deps files and lock sums. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows (lint/test/release) - [x] Add reusable workflow template - [x] Improve cache key patterns and restore-keys - [x] Pin major GH Action versions - [x] Add concurrency limits and reduce matrix size - [x] Validate on public and enterprise runners Testing: Verified on fork and internal runners. Initial CI run surfaced a flaky e2e test (tests/e2e/session_timeout_test) which I fixed by increasing a test timeout and stabilizing a mock. After rerun all checks passed. Rollout notes: Gradual rollout is safe; workflows live under .github/workflows. Team owners should watch pipeline runtimes and cache hit rates for the next 2 weeks (Console dashboard: CI -> Actions). If customers rely on release automation hooks, check that the release workflow preserved tagging semantics. Related: ENG-2391 for CI performance goals, SUP-4122 incident that motivated splitting release automation.
commits: Add reusable workflow template .github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml and reference from lint/test
Introduce scripts/ci/cache-key.sh and update actions/cache usage across workflows
Pin major GH Action versions and update action inputs for compatibility
Adjust test matrix and add job concurrency/needs to reduce queue pressure
Fix flaky e2e/session_timeout_test by adjusting timeout and mock behavior
files_changed: .github/workflows/lint.yml - new workflow focused on lint/lint-fmt jobs (node matrix reduced)
.github/workflows/test.yml - runs unit and integration tests, staged integration jobs to allow parallelization
.github/workflows/release.yml - simplified release automation, moved heavy artifact steps out to release workflow
.github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml - reusable template for checkout, cache restore, install, and test steps
scripts/ci/cache-key.sh - helper to compute deterministic cache keys from lockfiles
package.json - devDependency bumps for eslint (7.x -> 8.x) and prettier hygiene
.github/actions/README.md - docs for owners on updating the reusable workflow
tests/e2e/session_timeout_test.py - flakiness fix (timeout increased, deterministic mock)
pipelines/runner-config.yml - minor runner tagging tweaks for enterprise runners
docs/ci/ci-metrics.md - notes about cache key and parallelism recommendations
review_thread:
Priya Shah: Can we avoid expanding the cache key with ephemeral data (e.g. CI run id)? I think the current key is deterministic enough, please prefer lockfile/hash based keys.
Ethan Li: Agreed, switched to lockfile hash via scripts/ci/cache-key.sh. Restores use a shorter prefix to improve hit rate.
Marisol Ortega: Release workflow looks good but please confirm tag format doesn't change for the release automation consumers.
Ethan Li: Confirmed, preserved tag format 'redwood/v{version}' and kept the release payload unchanged. Added unit test in release workflow for tag generation.
Samir Patel: Initial CI failed on e2e timeout. Is it safe to increase the timeout? Could mask a real performance regression.
Ethan Li: Investigated — the test was flaking due to a race in the mock server startup. Increased timeout and added deterministic ready-check to avoid masking regressions. Added an integration smoke job to surface regressions early.
Priya Shah: Approving after cache key change and tests passing.
Marisol Ortega: Approved.
Merge: Squash and merge after last green run.
ci_checks: lint (eslint + prettier) - success - reduced matrix runtime from ~12m to ~4m
gha-cache-hit - improved (approx +22% hit rate observed in initial runs)
release_notes: Refactor CI: split lint/test/release workflows; add reusable workflow templates; improve actions/cache keys and restore patterns; pin major GH Action versions; reduce matrix size and add concurrency controls; fix flaky e2e test. Expect faster CI (notable reduction in lint runtime) and better cache hit rates.
